requirements: R1: Implement real product code to fix HTTP 401 errors for valid authenticated requests and integrate Moodle SSO with role mapping, resolving PR #1758 and PR #1759 falsification findings.

R2: Ensure the backend controllers or services actually execute the intended behavior instead of relying solely on mock tests, verifying the resolution of the specification coverage and PR refusal criteria violations.
R3: Enforce strict adherence to agent conversation maxims when providing PR critical reasons to resolve the methodological finding (DEVID_VELLEMAN_09_CONVERSATION_MAXIM).

slices.title: Resolve Moodle SSO and HTTP 401 defects with real product implementation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the real product code for this epic, I want to replace test stubs with actual backend logic that correctly handles authenticated Moodle SSO requests and role mapping, so that valid requests return 200/201 instead of 401 errors, and the system is genuinely usable rather than just passing faked tests.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a valid authenticated request from an external Moodle SSO provider
When the request reaches the backend API controllers
Then the system must correctly map the user's Moodle roles
And return a 200 OK or 201 Created response without relying on mock test servers

Given the need to provide automated PR review verdicts
When evaluating a PR that attempts to fix issues solely by modifying tests
Then the automated review must return a 'block' verdict and explicitly detail the missing product code in the criticalReason field
